Our breadboard prototyping tool METABOARD was recently accepted into the Telstra muru-d accelerator Interview Round. We hope it will help bring software developers further into the fold of electronics.

When I am simulating a circuit on breadboard, I notice, as the complexity of the circuit increases, I have to manually manage a mess of peripheral components and wiring. To solve this problem, I want to build a device that augments the breadboard to replace peripheral components and wire with programmatic internal components.

On top of this function, I want the device to route each pin to all other pins, so I can reconfigure and check all pins of the same value simultaneously with high level software interfaces such as Arduino.

I also want to download and share my designs with other developers without having to document or illustrate the arrangement and configuration of components.

At present, we require funds to finalise design and mass produce this device, but we have already built a working prototype that demonstrates its utility.

If you interested, check out this video of our first working prototype https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2D-xQ0YyXPI or ask questions below. For early users, we have launched a Indiegogo today: https://igg.me/at/themetaboard
We are giving software developers programmatic control over their breadboards.
